top_signals.title: Moody’s Warns Senegal Debt Revamp Likely Constitutes Default
top_signals.summary: Moody’s Ratings said Senegal’s bid to revamp billions of dollars of debt will probably constitute a default under its methodology, even as Africa’s most distressed sovereign issuer continues to make scheduled payments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: US Stock Rout Pauses as AI Trade Draws Buyers: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The selloff in US stocks paused, with dip buyers moving in to support the bruised artificial intelligence trade after the S&P 500’s steepest drop in more than a year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
